steps.recommendation: The survey did not find one winning change. With 3 people, answers split evenly in both rounds. If you must pick one, make attending easier: a closer or easier-to-reach venue, or a flexible drop-in option. These match what people wrote about bus fares, evening shifts and finding a weekly commitment hard. Shorter meetings looks like the weakest idea, and nobody asked for a different day or time.
steps.evidence: Round 1 (3 of 3 answered): closer venue 1, shorter meetings 1, more interesting content 1, day/time 0. Attendance in the last 4 meetings: 0 for one person, 2 for one, 3 for one. Round 2 (3 of 3 answered): most wanted was closer venue 1, more variety 1, flexible drop-in 1, shorter meetings 0. Least cared about: venue 1, shorter meetings 1, variety 1, drop-in 0. Free text: bus fares and shifts; an agenda sent ahead and a regular schedule; one person was happy as things are.
